sum: Nocera, Inc., an acquisition-focused company, provides land-based recirculating aquaculture system services to aquaculture projects. It engages in fish farming, sells aquatic products, and produces food products. The company designs, builds, and procures the equipment needed to build and operate land-based fish farms. It also offers engineering procurement construction solutions to the aquaculture industry. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
